SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN LOWER(onshore_offshore) = 'offshore' AND (LOWER(asset_name) LIKE '%mumbai%' OR LOWER(basin) LIKE '%western offshore%' OR LOWER(asset_name) LIKE '%western%' OR LOWER(asset_name) LIKE '%neelam%' OR LOWER(asset_name) LIKE '%b&s%' OR LOWER(asset_name) LIKE '%bassein%') THEN 'Western Offshore'
        WHEN LOWER(onshore_offshore) = 'onshore' AND (LOWER(basin) LIKE '%assam%' OR LOWER(asset_name) LIKE '%assam%' OR LOWER(asset_name) LIKE '%jorhat%' OR LOWER(asset_name) LIKE '%nazira%') THEN 'Assam Onshore'
        WHEN LOWER(onshore_offshore) = 'onshore' AND (LOWER(basin) LIKE '%cambay%' OR LOWER(asset_name) LIKE '%gujarat%' OR LOWER(asset_name) LIKE '%ahmedabad%' OR LOWER(asset_name) LIKE '%ankleshwar%' OR LOWER(asset_name) LIKE '%mehsana%') THEN 'Gujarat Onshore'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS region_group,
    COUNT(DISTINCT field_id) as field_count,
    SUM(total_production_boe) as total_prod_boe,
    ROUND(SUM(lifting_cost_per_boe_usd * total_production_boe) / NULLIF(SUM(total_production_boe), 0), 2) as weighted_avg_lifting_cost_usd,
    ROUND(AVG(lifting_cost_per_boe_usd), 2) as simple_avg_lifting_cost_usd
FROM hrfin_gold.v_field_pnl
WHERE field_id IS NOT NULL 
  AND fiscal_year IN ('FY26', '2026')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_prod_boe DESC
